createTime.description: Unix timestamp when the comment was posted
createTime.title: Create Time (Unix)

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime when the comment was posted
createdAt.title: Created At

images.description: Raw image_list from TikTok for comments with image attachments
images.title: Images

isLikedByAuthor.description: Whether the post author liked this comment (heart)
isLikedByAuthor.title: Liked By Author

isPinnedByAuthor.description: Whether the post author pinned this comment
isPinnedByAuthor.title: Pinned By Author

isReply.description: True if this is a reply to another comment
isReply.title: Is Reply

isTranslatable.description: Whether TikTok offers a translation for this comment
isTranslatable.title: Is Translatable

labels.description: Raw label_list entries TikTok attaches to the comment
labels.title: Labels

language.description: Detected language code of the comment text
language.title: Language

likeCount.description: Number of likes/diggs on this comment
likeCount.title: Like Count

postId.description: TikTok post/video ID this comment belongs to
postId.title: Post ID

replyCount.description: Total number of replies to this comment
replyCount.title: Reply Count

replyToCommentId.description: ID of the root comment this row replies to (reply rows)

replyToNickname.description: Display name of the comment/reply being answered

replyToReplyId.description: For nested replies, the ID of the reply this row answers

replyToUserId.description: Numeric user ID of the comment/reply being answered
replyToUserId.title: Reply To User ID

replyToUsername.description: Handle of the comment/reply being answered

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the row was collected
scrapedAt.title: Scraped At

shareUrl.description: TikTok share link that opens this comment

stickers.description: Raw cmt_sticker_struct when the comment uses a sticker
stickers.title: Stickers

textExtra.description: Raw textExtra entries from TikTok API — contains hashtags, mentions, and other inline annotations in the comment text

threadId.description: Thread identifier grouping root comment + all its replies
threadId.title: Thread ID

bio.description: Commenter profile bio when set (with 'Include commenter details')
bio.title: Bio

followerCount.description: Commenter's exact follower count (with 'Include commenter follower counts')
followerCount.title: Follower Count

followingCount.description: Commenter's exact following count (with 'Include commenter follower counts')
followingCount.title: Following Count

heartCount.description: Total likes received by the commenter (with 'Include commenter follower counts')
heartCount.title: Heart Count

region.description: Country/region code TikTok reports for the commenter (with 'Include commenter details')
region.title: Region

videoCount.description: Number of public videos on the commenter's profile (with 'Include commenter follower counts')
videoCount.title: Video Count

video.description: Caption, author and stats of the source video (only when 'Include video metadata' is on)

overview.description: TikTok comments with engagement metrics and author info.

replies.description: Only reply rows, keyed by the root comment they answer.
